architecture_type: Dual-Mode Local Execution (Client-Side Browser / Offline Python CLI)

execution_stages.name: Local File Ingestion
execution_stages.description: Reads raw .xlsx file into local browser ArrayBuffer (ExcelJS) or local Python memory (BytesIO). Zero network transmission.

execution_stages.name: Defensive Schema Validation
execution_stages.description: Validates presence of mandatory column keywords against csat_raw_input_schema.json before processing.

execution_stages.name: Dictionary Normalization & Group Ordering
execution_stages.description: Maps raw aliases to standardized corporate groups and orders respondents deterministically via local config dictionaries.

execution_stages.name: Transposed Matrix & Formula Injection
execution_stages.description: Builds horizontal client comparison blocks, injects dynamic SUM/AVERAGE formulas, and flags scores < 7 in bold red (#FF0000).

execution_stages.name: Client-Side File Export
execution_stages.description: Generates formatted .xlsx workbook locally via FileSaver.js or local filesystem write.

execution_stages.name: Volatile Memory Purge
execution_stages.description: Explicitly deletes DataFrames and invokes gc.collect() to eliminate residual sensitive data in RAM.
